segments.zh: 但他們專注於價值,推出了超過7,000項降價商品,比上一季大幅增加。

segments.text: Clearly doubling down on price leadership. But it's not all about discounts, is it?
segments.zh: 顯然在價格領導地位上加倍投入。但這並不完全只是關於折扣,對吧?

segments.text: Luxury seems okay. Not at all. Hermes reported growth everywhere.
segments.zh: 奢侈品市場看起來也還不錯。完全沒錯。愛馬仕在各地都通報成長。

segments.text: Japan up 16%. America's up 12%. They credit loyal, local clients in their value strategy,
segments.zh: 日本成長16%,美國成長12%。他們將此歸功於忠誠的在地客群和他們的價值策略,

segments.text: which for them means, you know, craftsmanship, exclusivity.
segments.zh: 對他們來說,這代表的是工藝技術和獨特性。

segments.text: A different kind of value. And L'Oreal is adapting too. Skincare face some headwinds,
segments.zh: 這是另一種形式的價值。萊雅也在做出調整。保養品業務面臨一些逆風,

segments.text: especially in North Asia. So what are they doing?
segments.zh: 尤其是在北亞地區。那他們是怎麼因應的?

segments.text: Acquisitions Medic, Dr. G, and rolling out the affordable Mixa brand in Europe.
segments.zh: 收購了Medik8和Dr.G,並在歐洲推出平價品牌Mixa。

segments.text: But here's the AI link again. L'Oreal is using AI heavily in R&D. Predictive formulation,
segments.zh: 但這裡又出現了AI的連結。萊雅大量將AI運用在研發上,包括預測配方、

segments.text: scanning molecules, building an AI moat for future innovation.
segments.zh: 分子掃描,為未來的創新打造AI護城河。

segments.text: Fascinating, even in cosmetics and P&G. Still commanding pricing power.
segments.zh: 真有意思,連化妝品業都是如此。而寶僑仍然掌握著強大的定價能力。

segments.text: Seems so. They operate in daily use categories where performance drives choice, right?
segments.zh: 看起來是如此。他們經營的是日常用品品類,消費者選擇是由效果驅動的,對吧?

segments.text: They said price has been a positive growth driver for 19 in the last 20 years.
segments.zh: 他們說,在過去20年中有19年,價格都是正向的成長動能。

segments.text: Wow. Consistency.
segments.zh: 哇,相當一致。

segments.text: An ongoing innovation-tied Evo, new Oral-B toothbrushes, supports that.
segments.zh: 持續不斷的創新——像是新款歐樂B牙刷——也支撐了這一點。

segments.text: Even with tariffs hitting some skews, the overall price increase averages out around
segments.zh: 即使關稅衝擊了部分品項,整體漲價幅度平均下來大約是

segments.text: 2.5%, kind of in line with inflation.
segments.zh: 2.5%,大致與通膨水準相符。

segments.text: Okay, and one last consumer shift, Philip Morris International.
segments.zh: 好,最後一個消費者趨勢的變化,菲利普莫里斯國際。

segments.text: Yeah, this is a big one. Their smoke-free products are just exploding.
segments.zh: 對,這是個很大的變化。他們的無煙產品正在爆炸性成長。

segments.text: In Japan, 10 million users. IQS is nearly half the total nicotine volume there now.
segments.zh: 在日本,已經有1,000萬用戶。IQOS現在幾乎佔了當地尼古丁總銷量的一半。

segments.text: And in the US.
segments.zh: 而在美國,

segments.text: ZYN saw huge growth, over 36% in June-July, growing with the market.
segments.zh: ZYN成長非常驚人,6到7月成長超過36%,與市場一同成長。

segments.text: And crucially, the smoke-free business has a gross margin around 70% higher
segments.zh: 而且關鍵在於,無煙業務的毛利率比他們傳統香菸業務

segments.text: than their traditional cigarette business. That's a major strategic win.
segments.zh: 高出大約70%。這是一項重大的策略性勝利。

segments.text: Yeah. Okay, from the consumer's wallet, let's pivot.
segments.zh: 對。好,從消費者的荷包轉個話題。

segments.text: The financial sector. Banks, payments. What's the pulse there?
segments.zh: 來看金融產業,銀行、支付,那裡的脈動如何?

segments.text: Credit, interest rates, digital transactions.
segments.zh: 信貸、利率、數位交易。

segments.text: Well, it's a bit of a mix again. Solid performance in some areas,
segments.zh: 嗯,這裡的情況也是喜憂參半。有些領域表現穩健,

segments.text: but ongoing challenges too. Cheaply Morgan Chase, for instance.
segments.zh: 但也持續面臨挑戰。以摩根大通為例,

segments.text: Net income up 13%. Revenue up 9%.
segments.zh: 淨利成長13%,營收成長9%。

segments.text: Market revenue looks strong up 15%.
segments.zh: 市場業務營收表現強勁,成長15%。

segments.text: But credit losses.
segments.zh: 但信貸損失方面,

segments.text: Yeah, they set aside $2.8 billion for provisions, mostly in card services.
segments.zh: 對,他們提撥了28億美元的準備金,主要集中在信用卡業務。

segments.text: Net charge-offs were $2.4 billion.
segments.zh: 淨沖銷金額為24億美元。

segments.text: And Jamie Dimon had some strong words for regulators, didn't he?
segments.zh: 而傑米・戴蒙對監管機關講了一些相當強硬的話,對吧?

segments.text: He really did. Called for simplification, transparency,
segments.zh: 確實如此。他呼籲要簡化、要透明,

segments.text: making things cheaper, safer. Criticized the overlap between rules like SLR, G-Sci-Fi,
segments.zh: 讓成本更低、更安全。他批評了像SLR、GSIB附加費、

segments.text: C-Share-R-Arrel, Basel-3.
segments.zh: CCAR壓力測試、巴塞爾協定三這些規則之間的重疊。

segments.text: He mentioned C-R-Arenus.
segments.zh: 他提到了CCAR。

segments.text: Yeah, suggesting the stress test might actually be holding back small business
segments.zh: 對,暗示壓力測試實際上可能正在限制中小企業

segments.text: lending. It really highlights that tension between regulation and market fluidity.
segments.zh: 貸款的發放。這確實凸顯了監管與市場流動性之間的緊張關係。

segments.text: A key point. How about Bank of America? Similar picture on credit.
segments.zh: 這是個重點。那美國銀行呢?信貸方面的情況類似,

segments.text: Provisions for credit losses were up slightly, but net charge-offs held steady year over
segments.zh: 信貸損失準備金小幅上升,但淨沖銷金額與去年同期

segments.text: year. And their net interest income increased, so the high-rate environment is still helping
segments.zh: 大致持平。而他們的淨利息收入則有所增加,顯示高利率環境仍在幫助

segments.text: their core lending business.
segments.zh: 他們的核心放貸業務。

segments.text: And Berkshire Hathaway. Always an interesting one.
segments.zh: 還有波克夏海瑟威,一如既往地有意思。

segments.text: Their overall revenues were down slightly, net earnings significantly lower,
segments.zh: 他們整體營收小幅下滑,淨利明顯降低,

segments.text: but that was mainly due to swings in investment gains losses.
segments.zh: 但這主要是受到投資損益波動的影響。

segments.text: Equity investments showed that volatility a big loss noted for Kraft Heinz,
segments.zh: 股權投資顯示出這種波動性,卡夫亨氏這筆投資出現重大虧損,

segments.text: but a gain for Occidental.
segments.zh: 但西方石油那筆則獲利。

segments.text: So diversification, doing its job, smoothing things somewhat, any share buybacks?
segments.zh: 所以多元化投資確實發揮了作用,某種程度上緩和了波動。有沒有股票回購?

segments.text: No, none reported in the first half of 2025.
segments.zh: 沒有,2025年上半年沒有回購紀錄。

segments.text: And they highlighted ongoing legal challenges, wildfires involving Pacific Corps,
segments.zh: 他們也提到了持續進行中的法律糾紛,包括涉及太平洋電力公司的野火案,

segments.text: and that big verdict against their real estate brokerage over commissions.
segments.zh: 以及針對他們旗下不動產仲介公司佣金問題的重大判決。

segments.text: Show us the diverse risks even they face.
segments.zh: 這讓我們看到,就連他們也面臨著各式各樣的風險。

segments.text: Okay, shifting to payments tech. Mastercard.
segments.zh: 好,換到支付科技,萬事達卡。

segments.text: They're pushing contactless tap to pay everywhere.
segments.zh: 他們正在各地推廣感應式付款。

segments.text: Shanghai Metro, 60 other transport operators globally.
segments.zh: 包括上海地鐵,以及全球另外60家運輸業者。

segments.text: And their view on stablecoins is interesting.
segments.zh: 而他們對穩定幣的看法也很有意思。

segments.text: What's their take?
segments.zh: 他們的看法是什麼?

segments.text: They see them as additive, providing on-off ramps from fiat currency, interoperability,
segments.zh: 他們認為穩定幣是加分項,能提供法幣的進出通道、互通性、

segments.text: reach, trust for specific use cases.
segments.zh: 觸及範圍,以及在特定使用情境下的信任度。

segments.text: It's about integrating, not competing.
segments.zh: 重點在於整合,而不是競爭。

segments.text: And using AI.
segments.zh: 而且也用了AI。

segments.text: Oh yeah, big time.
segments.zh: 喔對,而且是大規模運用。

segments.text: Using generative AI and their Decision Intelligence Pro
segments.zh: 運用生成式AI和他們的Decision Intelligence Pro,

segments.text: to move from preventing fraud to predicting it.
segments.zh: 從「防範詐騙」進化到「預測詐騙」。

segments.text: That's a significant step up in security strategy.
segments.zh: 這在安全策略上是重大的躍進。

segments.text: Predicting fraud, powerful stuff.
segments.zh: 預測詐騙,很厲害的東西。

segments.text: Visa thinking along similar lines with stablecoins.
segments.zh: Visa在穩定幣上的想法也類似。

segments.text: Very similar.
segments.zh: 非常相似。

segments.text: They see stablecoins solving real problems,
segments.zh: 他們認為穩定幣能解決真實存在的問題,

segments.text: especially in emerging markets with volatile currencies or limited financial access.
segments.zh: 尤其是在貨幣波動劇烈或金融普及度有限的新興市場。

segments.text: Visa's role. Providing the trust, standards, connectivity scale.
segments.zh: Visa的角色,是提供信任、標準,以及連結規模。

segments.text: The infrastructure layer for this evolving ecosystem.
segments.zh: 也就是這個不斷演進的生態系的基礎設施層。

segments.text: They also reported strong cross-border volume growth,
segments.zh: 他們也通報跨境交易量強勁成長,

segments.text: with Visa Direct becoming a key global remittance tool.
segments.zh: Visa Direct正成為全球匯款的重要工具。

segments.text: They're embedding themselves in these new flows.
segments.zh: 他們正把自己嵌入這些新的資金流動之中。

segments.text: And briefly, Bank of China.
segments.zh: 簡單提一下中國銀行。

segments.text: They reported solid loan growth up nearly 7% to RMB $23 trillion.
segments.zh: 他們通報放貸穩健成長,增加了將近7%,達到人民幣23兆元。

segments.text: Emphasize their role as a state-owned bank supporting national strategies and the real economy.
segments.zh: 強調他們身為國有銀行,在支持國家戰略和實體經濟上的角色。

segments.text: All right, let's move into healthcare and pharma.
segments.zh: 好,我們來看醫療保健與製藥產業。

segments.text: This sector is always fascinating.
segments.zh: 這個領域一向都很吸引人。

segments.text: Drug developments, devices, market expansion.
segments.zh: 藥物開發、醫療器材、市場擴張。

segments.text: R&D seems to be paying off.
segments.zh: 研發投入似乎正開花結果。

segments.text: It's definitely seeing some big results.
segments.zh: 確實看到了一些重大成果。

segments.text: Abview, for example.
segments.zh: 比如艾伯維,

segments.text: Net revenues grew 6.5%.
segments.zh: 淨營收成長了6.5%。

segments.text: Operationally, they raised their full-year guidance.
segments.zh: 就營運面來說,他們上調了全年財測。

segments.text: SkyRizzy and Renflexes are on track for over $25 billion combined this year.
segments.zh: Skyrizi和Rinvoq今年合計有望突破250億美元。

segments.text: $25 billion? That's huge.
segments.zh: 250億美元?這數字太驚人了。

segments.text: Yeah.
segments.zh: 對啊。

segments.text: Exceeding expectations.
segments.zh: 超出預期。

segments.text: Yeah, and their neuroscience portfolio also saw strong double-digit growth,
segments.zh: 對,他們的神經科學產品組合也出現強勁的雙位數成長,

segments.text: driven by VILEV and migraine treatments.
segments.zh: 由Vraylar和偏頭痛治療藥物所帶動。

segments.text: Plus, they're actively doing deals, collaborations, in licensing,
segments.zh: 此外,他們也積極進行交易、合作、授權引進,

segments.text: really building out that pipeline.
segments.zh: 確實在擴充他們的產品線。

segments.text: It's that dual strategy, isn't it?
segments.zh: 這就是那種雙軌策略,對吧?

segments.text: Maximize the current blockbusters while aggressively fueling the future pipeline.
segments.zh: 一邊將現有的重磅產品極大化,一邊積極為未來的產品線注入動能。

segments.text: Abbots doing impressive stuff in medical devices, too.
segments.zh: 亞培在醫療器材領域也做出了令人印象深刻的成績。

segments.text: Like what?
segments.zh: 比如說?

segments.text: Electrophysiology saw double-digit growth, launched a new catheter,
segments.zh: 電生理學業務出現雙位數成長,推出了新款導管,

segments.text: structural heart up 12%, driven by several key products.
segments.zh: 結構性心臟病業務成長12%,由幾項關鍵產品帶動。

segments.text: Their cardiac rhythm management business is showing very sustainable growth.
segments.zh: 他們的心律管理業務展現出非常穩健、可持續的成長。

segments.text: And developing new tech.
segments.zh: 而且也在開發新科技。

segments.text: Absolutely.
segments.zh: 絕對如此。

segments.text: A next-gen AVER device with 25% longer battery life is in the works.
segments.zh: 一款電池續航力延長25%的次世代心臟去顫器正在研發中。

segments.text: Parking a pivotal trial for a new pacing product in 2026.
segments.zh: 一項新型節律器產品的關鍵試驗預計在2026年展開。

segments.text: Plus, they're rolling out products globally in 50 countries,
segments.zh: 此外,他們正在全球50個國家推出產品,

segments.text: and still looking at M&A, a broad growth strategy.
segments.zh: 同時仍在物色併購機會,整體是相當廣泛的成長策略。

segments.text: Johnson & Johnson also showing breath.
segments.zh: 嬌生也展現出廣泛的成長幅度。

segments.text: Strong growth in both innovative medicine and med tech.
segments.zh: 在創新藥物和醫療科技兩方面都有強勁成長。

segments.text: And lots of positive data readouts, right?
segments.zh: 而且有很多正面的數據結果對吧?

segments.text: Across a whole range of conditions,
segments.zh: 涵蓋了一整個範圍的病症,

segments.text: myasthenia gravis, multiple myeloma, arthritis, cancer.
segments.zh: 重症肌無力、多發性骨髓瘤、關節炎、癌症。

segments.text: Plus, they hit a milestone with their OTVAT robotic surgical system.
segments.zh: 此外,他們的Ottava機器人手術系統也達成了一個里程碑。

segments.text: First cases completed, more automation coming to the OR.
segments.zh: 首批手術案例已經完成,手術室將迎來更多自動化。

segments.text: Yeah, that's a trend to watch.
segments.zh: 對,這是個值得關注的趨勢。

segments.text: But maybe the biggest buzz is around obesity care.
segments.zh: 但或許最受矚目的話題是肥胖症治療領域。

segments.text: Lilly reported strong results.
segments.zh: 禮來公布了強勁的財報結果。

segments.text: Net income up 32%.
segments.zh: 淨利成長32%。

segments.text: And focusing R&D there?
segments.zh: 那研發重心也放在那裡嗎?

segments.text: Definitely.
segments.zh: 絕對如此。

segments.text: While overall R&D costs dipped due to a prior impairment,
segments.zh: 雖然整體研發支出因先前的減損而下滑,

segments.text: late-stage trial activity increased, primarily focused on obesity.
segments.zh: 但後期試驗活動增加了,主要集中在肥胖症領域。

segments.text: They're advancing amicretin, both subcutaneous and oral forms,
segments.zh: 他們正在推進amycretin,包含皮下注射和口服兩種劑型,

segments.text: into phase three next year.
segments.zh: 預計明年進入第三期試驗。

segments.text: And Novo Nordisk, they're the other big player here.
segments.zh: 而諾和諾德是這個領域的另一個大玩家。

segments.text: Dominant, really.
segments.zh: 真的是市場主導者。

segments.text: The global branded obesity market grew 141% in volume.
segments.zh: 全球品牌肥胖症藥物市場的銷量成長了141%。

segments.text: Novo's obesity care sales surged 58%.
segments.zh: 諾和諾德的肥胖症治療業務銷售額暴增58%。

segments.text: Like Lilly, they're also advancing amicretin to phase three.
segments.zh: 和禮來一樣,他們也在把amycretin推進到第三期試驗。

segments.text: The demand must be incredible.
segments.zh: 需求肯定驚人。

segments.text: So much so, they're committing massive capital,
segments.zh: 驚人到他們正投入巨額資本,

segments.text: DKK, 65 billion in 2025, just to expand manufacturing capacity.
segments.zh: 2025年就投入650億丹麥克朗,只為了擴充產能。

segments.text: Building out the whole supply chain.
segments.zh: 打造整條供應鏈。

segments.text: Ingredients, production, packaging.
segments.zh: 原料、生產、包裝。

segments.text: It's a huge bet on sustained growth.
segments.zh: 這是一場豪賭,賭的是持續性的成長。

segments.text: Wow. Roche also showing growth in pharma.
segments.zh: 哇。羅氏在製藥業務上也展現出成長。

segments.text: Yep, pharma division sales up 10%,
segments.zh: 對,製藥部門銷售成長10%,

segments.text: driven by strong performers like Phezgos, Aler, Hemlibra.
segments.zh: 由Piasky、Alecensa、Hemlibra等表現強勁的產品帶動。

segments.text: Diagnostics was stable, absorbing some pricing pressure in China.
segments.zh: 診斷業務表現穩定,吸收了部分來自中國的定價壓力。

segments.text: They're also investing heavily in R&D breast cancer, obesity,
segments.zh: 他們也大力投資研發,涵蓋乳癌、肥胖症、

segments.text: hypertension treatments, plus computational biology
segments.zh: 高血壓治療,再加上計算生物學

segments.text: and human model systems for early research.
segments.zh: 以及用於早期研究的人體模型系統。

segments.text: Looking for those selective high-impact bets.
segments.zh: 他們在尋找那些精選、高影響力的投資標的。

segments.text: And lastly, in Health United Health Group, any major news?
segments.zh: 最後,在健康保險領域,聯合健康集團有什麼重大消息嗎?

segments.text: More about focus and leadership.
segments.zh: 比較多是關於聚焦策略和領導層面。

segments.text: Refocusing on performance discipline.
segments.zh: 重新聚焦在績效紀律上。

segments.text: Bias for action.
segments.zh: 傾向於積極行動。

segments.text: Some key leadership changes announced at Optum,
segments.zh: Optum宣布了一些重要的領導層人事變動,

segments.text: aiming to re-energize product development.
segments.zh: 目的是為產品開發注入新的活力。

segments.text: Okay, let's shift to our final sectors.
segments.zh: 好,我們來看最後幾個產業。

segments.text: Energy, industrials, automotive.
segments.zh: 能源、工業、汽車。

segments.text: Core industries navigating some unique dynamics, supply chains,
segments.zh: 這些核心產業正在應對一些獨特的動態、供應鏈問題,

segments.text: and new tech-like autonomy.
segments.zh: 以及像自動駕駛這樣的新科技。

segments.text: Right. In energy, the picture was a bit down year-over-year for Chevron.
segments.zh: 對。在能源方面,雪佛龍的表現年比年略微下滑。

segments.text: Net income, 2.5 billion dollars.
segments.zh: 淨利25億美元,

segments.text: Down from 4.4 billion dollars.
segments.zh: 較去年的44億美元下滑。

segments.text: Revenue is also lower, partly hit by evaluation adjustment on HES shares.
segments.zh: 營收也較低,部分原因是受到赫斯股份估值調整的影響。

segments.text: Next on mobile.
segments.zh: 接下來是埃克森美孚。

segments.text: Earnings also down slightly from Q1,
segments.zh: 獲利也較第一季略微下滑,

segments.text: but they specifically highlighted the Permian production potential.
segments.zh: 但他們特別強調了二疊紀盆地的生產潛力。

segments.text: Suggest continued focus and investment in that key U.S. oil region.
segments.zh: 顯示他們會持續聚焦並投資在這個美國關鍵石油產區。

segments.text: Okay, moving to industrials.
segments.zh: 好,接下來看工業產業。

segments.text: GE Aerospace.
segments.zh: 奇異航空。

segments.text: Lots of focus on engines.
segments.zh: 很大的焦點放在引擎上。

segments.text: Working with Boeing on certifying a durability kit for the LAP-1B engine.
segments.zh: 與波音合作,為LEAP-1B引擎的耐久性套件進行認證。

segments.text: Rolling out blade improvements.
segments.zh: 推出葉片改良方案。

segments.text: Their big GE9X engine, the most tested ever,
segments.zh: 他們的大型GE9X引擎,是史上測試最多的引擎,

segments.text: went through dust testing prelaunch to inform design tweaks.
segments.zh: 在發售前經歷了粉塵測試,以此來調整設計。

segments.text: Sounds like long-term iterative improvement.
segments.zh: 聽起來像是長期的反覆迭代改良。

segments.text: How's business?
segments.zh: 那業務表現如何?

segments.text: Airbody engine revenue is beating expectations,
segments.zh: 窄體機引擎營收超出預期,

segments.text: thanks to LE growth and the long life of the older CFM56 fleet.
segments.zh: 這要歸功於LEAP引擎的成長,以及老舊CFM56機隊的長壽命。

segments.text: Widebody services expected to grow steadily too.
segments.zh: 寬體機服務業務預期也會穩定成長。

segments.text: They do anticipate a profit headwind next year from initial GE9X shipments,
segments.zh: 他們確實預期明年GE9X初期出貨會帶來獲利上的逆風,

segments.text: which usually have higher upfront losses.
segments.zh: 因為這類產品初期通常虧損較高。

segments.text: Makes sense.
segments.zh: 這說得通。

segments.text: Now, automotive and specifically Tesla.
segments.zh: 現在來看汽車產業,特別是特斯拉。

segments.text: Big focus on autonomy, right?
segments.zh: 焦點大多放在自動駕駛上,對吧?

segments.text: Huge focus.
segments.zh: 焦點非常集中。

segments.text: They hit a record 20% sequential jump in test drives in North America.
segments.zh: 他們在北美的試駕次數創下單季環比成長20%的紀錄。

segments.text: Launched a new long-range RWD Model Y variant to attract more buyers.
segments.zh: 推出了新款長續航後輪驅動Model Y車型,以吸引更多買家。

segments.text: And FSD, full self-driving.
segments.zh: 還有FSD,也就是完全自動駕駛。

segments.text: Preparing for a broader supervised release in China pending regulatory approval.
segments.zh: 正準備在中國推出範圍更廣的「有監督」版本,目前正等待監管批准。

segments.text: They also launched the Model Y in India.
segments.zh: 他們也在印度推出了Model Y。

segments.text: Big move into the world's third largest car market.
segments.zh: 這是進軍全球第三大汽車市場的重大一步。

segments.text: And the Robotaxi.
segments.zh: 還有Robotaxi無人計程車。

segments.text: They reported rolling it out in Austin, Texas.
segments.zh: 他們通報已在德州奧斯汀推出。

segments.text: And even autonomously delivered a car from the factory straight to a customer's home.
segments.zh: 甚至還做到讓車輛從工廠自動駕駛,直接送到顧客家門口。

segments.text: That's quite something.
segments.zh: 這相當了不起。

segments.text: What's the grand ambition there?
segments.zh: 那他們的終極野心是什麼?

segments.text: Their stated goal is to address half the population of the U.S.
segments.zh: 他們宣示的目標,是要在今年底前

segments.text: with autonomous ride-hailing by the end of this year.
segments.zh: 讓自動駕駛叫車服務覆蓋美國一半的人口。

segments.text: Subject to approvals, of course.
segments.zh: 當然,這要視監管核准情況而定。

segments.text: They expect service areas and vehicle numbers to grow at a hyper-exponential rate.
segments.zh: 他們預期服務範圍和車輛數量將以「超指數」的速度成長。

segments.text: Hyper-exponential, that's ambitious.
segments.zh: 超指數成長,野心真的很大。

segments.text: Very.
segments.zh: 非常大。

segments.text: They see FSD as the single biggest demand driver.
segments.zh: 他們認為FSD是單一最大的需求驅動因素。

segments.text: They're pushing for approvals in Europe and China too.
segments.zh: 他們也在推動歐洲和中國的監管核准。

segments.text: It really highlights the race between the tech and the regulators.
segments.zh: 這確實凸顯了科技與監管機關之間的競賽關係。

segments.text: Definitely a space to watch closely.
segments.zh: 絕對是個需要密切關注的領域。

segments.text: Okay, let's round things out with Telecom.
segments.zh: 好,我們用電信產業來做個總結。

segments.text: Keeping us connected, exploring new stuff like satellite services.
segments.zh: 讓我們保持連線,同時也在探索像衛星服務這樣的新事物。

segments.text: Right.
segments.zh: 沒錯。

segments.text: T-Mobile US reported fabulously well.
segments.zh: T-Mobile美國公司的財報表現極為亮眼。

segments.text: ARPA growth average revenue per account.
segments.zh: 每帳戶平均營收(ARPA)成長。

segments.text: Underpinning service revenue growth of at least 6%.
segments.zh: 支撐服務營收成長至少6%。

segments.text: And satellite is playing a role.
segments.zh: 而衛星服務也發揮了作用。

segments.text: Apparently so.
segments.zh: 顯然如此。

segments.text: They said T-Satellite surprised even them with its contribution to ARPA growth.
segments.zh: 他們說T-Satellite對ARPA成長的貢獻程度,連他們自己都感到驚訝。

segments.text: It's helping them serve rural markets where their wind share is much higher than their
segments.zh: 這幫助他們服務鄉村市場,在那裡他們的市佔率遠高於

segments.text: overall household share suggests.
segments.zh: 整體家庭市佔率所顯示的水準。

segments.text: This is finding new customers.
segments.zh: 這就是在開發新客戶。

segments.text: Exactly.
segments.zh: 沒錯。

segments.text: It fits their dual strategy.
segments.zh: 這符合他們的雙軌策略。

segments.text: Maximize returns from existing fallow capacity, unused network,
segments.zh: 從現有閒置產能,也就是未使用的網路資源中將回報極大化,

segments.text: and smartly invest in new opportunities like the planned merger with US cellular
segments.zh: 同時聰明地投資新機會,像是計畫中與US Cellular的合併,

segments.text: to boost competitiveness in smaller rural markets.
segments.zh: 以提升在較小型鄉村市場的競爭力。

segments.text: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.text: We have covered a ton of ground today.
segments.zh: 我們今天涵蓋了非常多的內容。

segments.text: From that AI arms race and tech to how consumers are spending,
segments.zh: 從那AI軍備競賽和科技,到消費者的支出行為,

segments.text: health breakthroughs, finance, energy, connectivity, it's a huge landscape.
segments.zh: 醫療突破、金融、能源、連結性,這是一幅非常龐大的版圖。

segments.text: It really is.
segments.zh: 確實如此。

segments.text: And what stands out I think is how interconnected it all is.
segments.zh: 而我認為最突出的一點,是這一切彼此之間的高度連結。

segments.text: AI isn't just a tech thing, right?
segments.zh: AI不只是科技領域的事,對吧?

segments.text: It's enabling predictive fraud detection for MasterCard,
segments.zh: 它讓萬事達卡能做到預測性詐騙偵測,

segments.text: accelerating drug discovery for Lily and Roche,
segments.zh: 加速禮來和羅氏的藥物研發,

segments.text: optimizing retail supply chains for Walmart,
segments.zh: 優化沃爾瑪的零售供應鏈,

segments.text: powering Tesla's autonomous driving ambitions.
segments.zh: 為特斯拉的自動駕駛野心提供動力。

segments.text: And consumer behavior feeds right back into that.
segments.zh: 而消費者行為又直接回饋到這一切之中。

segments.text: People demand more personalized, efficient digital experiences,
segments.zh: 人們要求更個人化、更有效率的數位體驗,

segments.text: which in turn drives the need for all that tech infrastructure we started with.
segments.zh: 這又反過來推動了我們一開始提到的那些科技基礎設施的需求。

segments.text: Exactly.
segments.zh: 沒錯。

segments.text: It's this intricate web.
segments.zh: 這就是這張錯綜複雜的網。

segments.text: So as we wrap up, here's something to think about.
segments.zh: 所以在我們做總結之際,這裡有件事值得思考。

segments.text: We talked about all these big trends and results from these global giants,
segments.zh: 我們談了這些全球巨頭的所有重大趨勢和成果,

segments.text: but what seemingly minor innovation or trend we touched on today?
segments.zh: 但我們今天談到的哪個看似微小的創新或趨勢,

segments.text: What small seed could quietly grow into something massive,
segments.zh: 哪一顆小小的種子,可能悄悄長成龐然大物,

segments.text: something industry altering in the next five years?
segments.zh: 在未來五年內改變整個產業?

segments.text: Maybe it's the efficiency from Salesforce's agent force.
segments.zh: 或許是Salesforce的Agentforce所帶來的效率提升。

segments.text: Maybe it's the sheer scale of the obesity drug market.
segments.zh: 或許是肥胖症藥物市場那驚人的規模。

segments.text: Maybe it's that relentless push for more chip capacity.
segments.zh: 或許是那股對晶片產能不斷追求的動力。

segments.text: These earnings calls don't just tell us what happened.
segments.zh: 這些財報電話會議告訴我們的,不只是已經發生的事。

segments.text: They hint at what's becoming possible.
segments.zh: 它們也暗示了正在成為可能的事。

segments.text: Things that could fundamentally change aspects of your daily life
segments.zh: 那些可能從根本上改變你日常生活某些層面的事物,

segments.text: you might take for granted right now.
segments.zh: 而你現在可能還把它們視為理所當然。

segments.text: What will you be watching for?
segments.zh: 那你接下來會關注什麼呢?
